mods.name: Automagik Herdr
mods.blurb: Autonomous teams of coding agents across harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Kimi, Oh My Pi…)

mods.name: am-automations
mods.title: Automagik Automations
mods.blurb: Scheduled agent prompts, as a side panel: a prompt, a cron line and a repo — every weekday at 09:00 an agent starts in a fresh worktree and works. The panel is where you find what ran while you were away, start one now, pause them all, or write a new one with its next runs previe

mods.name: am-footer
mods.title: Automagik Footer
mods.blurb: The sidebar's footer as a rail of tabs instead of a stack of rows — robot **Bots** (first), puzzle **Mods**, clock **Automations**, gear **Settings**, plus **Add machine** — and the brand bar above it. Derived from Herdr's shipped `workspace-chrome` 0.1.11.

mods.name: am-markdown
mods.title: Automagik Markdown
mods.blurb: Right-click in a terminal and, under Herdr's own items, the Markdown files that terminal's text talks about; click one and it renders in a preview pane beside the chat. One mod, two faces.

mods.name: am-mods
mods.title: Automagik Mods
mods.blurb: A table of every mod in a Herdr app home, with the switches, versions and origins that let a person run their own mod set: install from a marketplace, update, switch off, remove — each after a review that lists what enters, what the code does, and which keys it takes.

mods.name: am-new-menu
mods.title: Automagik New Menu
mods.blurb: The `+` menu (the tab bar's `+`, and a space row's, in place of Herdr's stock one): start a terminal or an installed coding agent in the shown space (or a space row's `+`), make a new space, or open a worktree. Derived from Herdr's shipped `new-menu` 0.1.7; it asks herdr-core whi

mods.name: am-quota
mods.title: Automagik Quota
mods.blurb: One account per client, and the handoff before a window runs dry. The left sidebar panel lists every Claude Code and Codex account the CLIProxyAPI knows, with its window, and switches the *local* credentials so the clients use the one you pick — no proxy in the traffic path, no r

mods.name: am-sidebar
mods.title: Automagik Sidebar
mods.blurb: The sidebar of Automagik Herdr, and the bots in it: each project's main bot and its team, drawn with Automagik's characters, created and edited in one form, started on or attached to any coding agent, labelled for the agent event envelope, and briefed before every Claude turn. De

mods.name: am-tabs
mods.title: Automagik Tabs
mods.blurb: The window's tab bar: one pill per tab of the shown space, named from what runs in it, with a close ✕ on hover and on middle press, the side-panel buttons and the window buttons. Derived from Herdr's shipped `tabs`; the naming engine is this project's.

mods.name: Insights
mods.blurb: A native Herdr dashboard for token usage across Pi, Codex, Claude Code, and OpenCode. It reads existing local session data, shows model rankings and activity, and opens in its own tab without changing terminals, layouts, or keys.

mods.name: Pocket Link
mods.blurb: Pair a phone with this computer so Herdr Pocket reaches its agents from anywhere. The mod, its LaunchAgent and its pairing state live in automagik-pocket and are installed by that repo, never by this pack.
